properties.teleconnection_sensitivity: High vulnerability during El Niño Short Rains (OND) and Equatorial Wave surges (MAM)
properties.description: High-discharge outflow from Mt. Elgon and Cherang'any hills funneling through narrow lowland dykes; backflow from Lake Victoria backwaters submerging villages and farmland across Bunyala.
properties.doc_evidence: KFSSG Short Rains Assessment 2023; KMD Seasonal Flood Bulletins; NDMA Busia Early Warning.

properties.teleconnection_sensitivity: Extreme flood risk during El Niño and positive IOD Short Rains (OND 1997, 2019, 2023)
properties.description: Rapid torrential runoff from Nandi escarpment spreading across the flat alluvial Kano Plains; overtopping river training dykes, submerging Ahero rice irrigation paddies, and paralyzing the Kisumu–Kericho highway.
properties.doc_evidence: KFSSG SRA 2023/24; NDMA Kisumu Early Warning Bulletins; JRC GloFAS RP20 Hazard Assessment.

properties.hazard_type: Torrential Riverine Flash Deluges & Highway Approach Scouring
properties.teleconnection_sensitivity: Severe pulse flooding during enhanced OND convective rainfall
properties.description: Steep orographic runoff from Cherang'any hills surges down the Kerio canyon; repeatedly overtopping and washing out bridge approaches along the critical A1 Kitale–Lodwar transit artery.
properties.doc_evidence: NDMA Turkana Early Warning Bulletins; KFSSG Long/Short Rains Assessments; Kenya Red Cross Flood Dispatches.

properties.hazard_type: Transboundary Riverine Overflow & Urban Perimeter Submergence
properties.teleconnection_sensitivity: Extreme sensitivity to Ethiopian highland convective deluges during El Niño / +IOD (1997, 2019, 2023)
properties.description: Transboundary flood waves generated in the Ethiopian massif funnel into the Daua River, overtopping riverbanks in Mandera municipality, destroying riverbank irrigation pumps, and contaminating shallow boreholes.
properties.doc_evidence: NDMA Mandera Early Warning Bulletins; KFSSG National SRA 2023; KMD Flood Warnings.

properties.hazard_type: Major Riverine Overflow & Main Transit Artery Washout
properties.teleconnection_sensitivity: Highly sensitive to Upper Tana / Aberdare deluges and Seven Forks hydro cascade spills during El Niño / +IOD
properties.description: Severe riverine swelling breaching Garissa town flood dykes; extensive inundation of Mororo and Madogo settlements; submerging the A3 Nairobi–Garissa–Dadaab commercial artery.
properties.doc_evidence: KFSSG National SRA 2023/24; NDMA Garissa Drought Early Warning; UN OCHA Flood Sitreps.

properties.hazard_type: Expansive Meandering Floodplain Submergence & Delta Inundation
properties.teleconnection_sensitivity: Extreme cumulative flood accumulation during OND El Niño / +IOD surges
properties.description: Broad downstream fluvial dispersion spreading floodwaters across tens of kilometers of low-lying floodplains; cutting the B8 Malindi–Garsen–Garissa highway and displacing riverine pastoral and farming communities.
properties.doc_evidence: KFSSG National SRA 2023/24; NDMA Tana River Early Warning; Copernicus GFM SAR observations.

properties.teleconnection_sensitivity: High surge risk following heavy rainfall across Athi / Tsavo catchments
properties.description: Downstream funnel of the Athi-Galana-Sabaki system overtopping banks north of Malindi town; flooding agricultural settlements, bridge approaches, and irrigation schemes in Magarini.
properties.doc_evidence: KMD Coastal Marine & River Flood Alerts; NDMA Kilifi Early Warning; KFSSG Assessments.

properties.hazard_type: Inland Arid Basin Flood Spreading & Terminating Pan Swell
properties.teleconnection_sensitivity: Triggered by heavy rainfall on Mt. Kenya and Aberdare massifs during wet ENSO phases
properties.description: High-energy flash flows discharging into arid lowlands; washing out Gotu bridge and spreading into the expansive Lorian Swamp, cutting off rural feeder links between Isiolo and Wajir.
properties.doc_evidence: NDMA Isiolo Early Warning Bulletins; KFSSG Short Rains Assessments.

properties.hazard_type: Fluvial Riverbank Inundation & Municipal Crossing Washout
properties.teleconnection_sensitivity: High flood volumes during enhanced Mt. Elgon / Turkwel catchment rainfall
properties.description: Large fluvial discharges overtopping river training works in Lodwar municipality; submerging informal riverbank agriculture and threatening bridges along key relief routes.
properties.doc_evidence: NDMA Turkana Early Warning Bulletins; KFSSG LRA/SRA Reports.

properties.hazard_type: Closed Depression Inundation & Desert Inland Sea Accumulation
properties.teleconnection_sensitivity: Extreme accumulation during Super El Niño (1997, 2023) and record +IOD (2019)
properties.description: Internal convergence of torrential runoff from Ethiopian highlands and volcanic plateaus into a closed desert depression; creating a 1,500–2,100 km² inland sea that maroons Kalacha and North Horr for months.
properties.doc_evidence: Copernicus GFM Sentinel-1 SAR observations; NDMA Marsabit Early Warning Bulletins.

properties.hazard_type: Dry Sand-River Flash Surge & Trans-African Highway Severance
properties.teleconnection_sensitivity: High flash surge frequency during intense convective short rains
properties.description: Violent flash torrents rushing down dry ephemeral wadis overtopping bridge decks and washing out approach abutments along the paved A2 highway, severing transit between Nairobi and Ethiopia.
properties.doc_evidence: NDMA Marsabit Early Warning Bulletins; KFSSG Assessments; Copernicus GFM Road Exposure.

properties.hazard_type: Meandering River Overtopping & Lake Victoria Backwater
properties.teleconnection_sensitivity: High vulnerability during enhanced western Kenya seasonal rains
properties.description: Downstream confluence of Kuja and Migori rivers overflowing low dykes in Nyatike; submerging artisanal gold mining areas, maize plots, and lake shoreline settlements.
properties.doc_evidence: NDMA Migori Early Warning; KMD Western Kenya Weather Advisories.
